method: Real upstream media captured from carnival.com: itinerary and port day-tile images from Sitecore page data, ship hero photos and onboard venue photos from ship pages, destination heroes, full-size shore-excursion heroes harvested from upstream detail pages (scraped_data/exc_heros), homepage merchandise tiles; downloaded via scraped_data/download_images.py with per-file upstream URLs.
